domain_description: Real-time sensing, HVAC control, occupancy tracking, access management, and maintenance ticketing across a portfolio of commercial smart buildings.
author: Ontology Toolkit Wizard Example

entities.name: building
entities.label: Building
entities.description: A physical building in the portfolio with an address, gross floor area, and certification level.

entities.name: floor
entities.label: Floor
entities.description: A floor within a Building, identified by floor number and tenant zoning.

entities.name: room
entities.label: Room
entities.description: A leasable or service space on a Floor (office, meeting room, plant room, etc.).

entities.name: sensor
entities.label: Sensor
entities.description: A physical sensor (temperature, CO2, occupancy, door state, light level) installed in a Room.

entities.name: hvac_unit
entities.label: HVAC Unit
entities.description: A heating/ventilation/air-conditioning unit serving one or more Floors.

entities.name: tenant
entities.label: Tenant
entities.description: An organisation leasing one or more Rooms in a Building.

entities.name: access_card
entities.label: Access Card
entities.description: A physical or virtual credential issued to a person granting entry to specific Rooms.

entities.name: temperature_reading
entities.label: Temperature Reading
entities.description: An observation event — a temperature sample produced by a Sensor at a point in time.

entities.name: occupancy_event
entities.label: Occupancy Event
entities.description: An observation event — count of occupants in a Room at a point in time.

entities.name: access_event
entities.label: Access Event
entities.description: An entry/exit event raised when an Access Card is presented at a Room reader.

entities.name: maintenance_ticket
entities.label: Maintenance Ticket
entities.description: A work item raised against an HVAC Unit, Sensor, or Room with a severity and assigned engineer.

entities.name: alert
entities.label: Alert
entities.description: A system-generated alert (high temperature, intrusion, equipment failure) produced from sensor readings or rule triggers.

cqs: Which rooms are currently above their temperature setpoint?
Which HVAC units have open critical maintenance tickets?
Which sensors have not produced a reading in the last 30 minutes?
Which tenants occupy rooms with abnormal occupancy patterns this week?
Which access cards were used to enter restricted rooms outside business hours?
What is the average occupancy of each floor by hour of day?
Which buildings have the highest energy consumption per square metre?
Which alerts were raised but not acknowledged within their SLA?
